File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a flow file.

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: FlowFiles that could not be updated are routed to this relationship

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: FlowFiles that have been successfully processed are routed to this relationship. This includes both FlowFiles that had text replaced and those that did not.

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_gop_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp` (
    id_truc_giao, truc_giao, nhom_van_ban, linh_vuc, chu_de, muc_do_uu_tien, nv_quantam,
    ma_nhiem_vu, ten_nhiem_vu, van_ban_giao,
    id_don_vi_chu_tri, ten_don_vi_chu_tri, lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,
    ngay_giao, han_xu_ly, ngay_hoan_thanh, ngay_xoa,
    tinh_trang, tinh_hinh_ket_qua,
    ld_ubnd, ld_van_phong, phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi, chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,
    id_cha, task_id, status, so_luong_task, sync_date
)

SELECT
    /* 1. TRỤC GIAO & NHÓM VĂN BẢN */
    x.id_truc_giao,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.truc_giao     ORDER BY x.truc_giao     SEPARATOR ' | ')     AS truc_giao,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.nhom_van_ban  ORDER BY x.nhom_van_ban  SEPARATOR ' | ')     AS nhom_van_ban,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.linh_vuc      ORDER BY x.linh_vuc      SEPARATOR ' | ')     AS linh_vuc,

    /* CHỦ ĐỀ, MỨC ĐỘ ƯU TIÊN, NHIỆM VỤ QUAN TÂM */
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.chu_de         ORDER BY x.chu_de         SEPARATOR ' | ')   AS chu_de,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.muc_do_uu_tien ORDER BY x.muc_do_uu_tien SEPARATOR ' | ')   AS muc_do_uu_tien,
    MAX(x.nv_quantam)                                                                   AS nv_quantam,

    /* 2. NHIỆM VỤ & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.ma_nhiem_vu, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.ma_nhiem_vu, '-')), MAX(x.ma_nhiem_vu),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.ma_nhiem_vu, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | '))       AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    x.ten_nhiem_vu,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.van_ban_giao  ORDER BY x.van_ban_giao  SEPARATOR ' | ')     AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ */
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.id_don_vi_chu_tri, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.id_don_vi_chu_tri, '-')), MAX(x.id_don_vi_chu_tri),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.id_don_vi_chu_tri, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.ten_don_vi_chu_tri, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.ten_don_vi_chu_tri, '-')), MAX(x.ten_don_vi_chu_tri),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.ten_don_vi_chu_tri, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, '-')), MAX(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    /* 4. MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.ngay_giao, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.ngay_giao, '-')), MAX(x.ngay_giao),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.ngay_giao, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | '))   AS ngay_giao,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.han_xu_ly, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.han_xu_ly, '-')), MAX(x.han_xu_ly),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.han_xu_ly, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | '))   AS han_xu_ly,
    GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.ngay_hoan_thanh, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')   AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.ngay_xoa, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.ngay_xoa, '-')), MAX(x.ngay_xoa),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.ngay_xoa, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | '))   AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 5. TÌNH TRẠNG: tình trạng xấu nhất trong nhóm
       VD: Đã hoàn thành | Đã hoàn thành | Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn => Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn')   = 1 THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn') = 1 THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Thường xuyên')              = 1 THEN 'Thường xuyên'
        WHEN MAX(x.tinh_trang = 'Đã hoàn thành')             = 1 THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
    END                                                                                 AS tinh_trang,

    /* 6. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ */
    IF(MIN(COALESCE(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua, '-')) = MAX(COALESCE(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua, '-')), MAX(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua),
       GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(x.tinh_hinh_ket_qua, '-') ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')) AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* 7. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND / VĂN PHÒNG & CHUYÊN VIÊN VP THEO DÕI */
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ld_ubnd                   SEPARATOR ' | ')                  AS ld_ubnd,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.ld_van_phong              SEPARATOR ' | ')                  AS ld_van_phong,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi SEPARATOR ' | ')                  AS phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT x.chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi   SEPARATOR ' | ')                  AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,

    /* 8. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & ĐỒNG BỘ
       id_cha = task_id đầu tiên (nhỏ nhất) của nhóm + '_GR', khớp id_cha bên qlnv_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp */
    CONCAT(MIN(x.task_id), '_GR')                                                       AS id_cha,
    GROUP_CONCAT(x.task_id ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | ')                          AS task_id,
    IF(MIN(x.status) = MAX(x.status), MAX(x.status),
       GROUP_CONCAT(x.status ORDER BY x.task_id SEPARATOR ' | '))                        AS status,
    COUNT(*)                                                                            AS so_luong_task,
    NOW()                                                                               AS sync_date

FROM `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp` x

GROUP BY x.ten_nhiem_vu, x.id_truc_giao;

INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp` (
    id_truc_giao, truc_giao, nhom_van_ban, linh_vuc, chu_de, muc_do_uu_tien, nv_quantam,
    ma_nhiem_vu, ten_nhiem_vu, van_ban_giao,
    id_don_vi_chu_tri, ten_don_vi_chu_tri, lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,
    ngay_giao, han_xu_ly, ngay_hoan_thanh, ngay_xoa,
    tinh_trang, tinh_hinh_ket_qua,
    ld_ubnd, ld_van_phong, phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi, chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,
    task_id, id_cha, status, sync_date
)

SELECT
    /* 1. TRỤC GIAO & NHÓM VĂN BẢN */
    t.AssignDepartment                                                      AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), d_assign_cap2.name)          AS truc_giao,
    /* Nhóm văn bản: gắn tên theo số ký hiệu văn bản giao (DocCode), xét theo thứ tự từ trên xuống.
       Chỉ dùng để phân nhóm, KHÔNG dùng để lọc task */
    CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%CTr%'                 THEN 'Chương trình'
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%KH%'                  THEN 'Kế hoạch'
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP 'TB-(VP|UBND)'        THEN 'TBKL UBND Thành phố'
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE '%BCĐ%'                 THEN 'Triển khai thực hiện Nghị quyết số 57-NQ/TW'
        WHEN t.DocCode REGEXP '/(UBND|VP)-'         THEN 'Văn bản chỉ đạo'
        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END                                                                     AS nhom_van_ban,
    /* LĨNH VỰC: lĩnh vực văn bản (qlnv_sector qua resolution.SectorId); rỗng thì 'Khác' */
    COALESCE(NULLIF(s.SectorName, ''), 'Khác')                              AS linh_vuc,

    /* CHỦ ĐỀ, MỨC ĐỘ ƯU TIÊN, NHIỆM VỤ QUAN TÂM */
    tp.TopicName                                                            AS chu_de,
    CASE t.Priority
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
        ELSE 'Thường'
    END                                                                     AS muc_do_uu_tien,
    t.isFocus                                                               AS nv_quantam,

    /* 2. NHIỆM VỤ & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    t.Code                                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    t.DocCode                                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ: nhánh 1841/1307/1310 lấy cấp 4, còn lại cấp 3 */
    IF(t.TargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4),
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3))                         AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,
    d_chutri.name                                                           AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,
    ppl.lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien,

    /* 4. MỐC THỜI GIAN: Định dạng chuẩn ISO yyyy-mm-dd */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%Y-%m-%d')                                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 5. 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4) AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL                                       THEN 'Thường xuyên'
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
        THEN IF(t.ExpireDate >= CURDATE(), 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn', 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn')
    END                                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 6. TÌNH HÌNH, KẾT QUẢ: báo cáo mới nhất, fallback nội dung task */
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT rp.Content
         FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp
         WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL
         ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC
         LIMIT 1),
        t.Content
    )                                                                       AS tinh_hinh_ket_qua,

    /* 7. LÃNH ĐẠO UBND / VĂN PHÒNG & CHUYÊN VIÊN VP THEO DÕI */
    ppl.ld_ubnd,
    ppl.ld_van_phong,
    IF(u_create.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(d_create.name, ''), NULL)              AS phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi,
    IF(u_create.DepartmentPath LIKE '490.698.752%', NULLIF(u_create.eGovUserFullname, ''), NULL)  AS chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi,

    /* 8. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & ĐỒNG BỘ */
    t.TaskId                                                                AS task_id,
    /* id_cha: task_id đầu tiên (nhỏ nhất) cùng (tên nhiệm vụ, trục giao) + '_GR', khớp id_cha bảng gộp */
    MAX(g.id_cha)                                                           AS id_cha,
    t.Status                                                                AS status,
    '${sync_ts}'                                                            AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* RESOLUTION */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL

/* LĨNH VỰC VĂN BẢN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_sector` s
       ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
      AND s.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND s.IsActive = 1

/* CHỦ ĐỀ NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_topic` tp
       ON tp.TopicId = t.TopicId

/* TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                                CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (id cuối của mã đã chuẩn hóa cấp) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = IF(
              SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.TargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                 SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4),
                                 SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
              CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(IF(t.TargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4),
                                      SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED),
              NULL)
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI TẠO & PHÒNG BAN NGƯỜI TẠO */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_create
       ON u_create.eGovUserId = t.CreateUser
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_create
       ON d_create.id = IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$',
                           CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(u_create.DepartmentPath, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED), NULL)
      AND d_create.IsDelete = 0

/* NGƯỜI LIÊN QUAN THEO TASK */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.TaskId,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dept, u.DepartmentPath) = '490.698'
                  AND LOWER(u.eGovUserPositionName) LIKE '%lãnh đạo%'
                  AND u.eGovUserPositionLevel = 2
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_ubnd,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) = '490.698.752'
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title, NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.src, p.Role DESC, p.Id DESC SEPARATOR ', ') AS ld_van_phong,

        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN p.src = 0
                  AND COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DepartmentPath, ''), p.dept) LIKE CONCAT(
                          IF(p.TargetDepartment REGEXP '^490[.]698[.](1841|1307|1310)',
                             SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.TargetDepartment, '.', 4),
                             SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)), '%')
                 THEN NULLIF(TRIM(CONCAT_WS(' - ', ujt.job_title,
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.eGovUserFullname), ''),
                                            NULLIF(TRIM(u.PhoneNumber), ''))), '')
            END
            ORDER BY p.Role, ujt.job_title, u.eGovUserFullname SEPARATOR ', ') AS lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien

    FROM (
        SELECT tu.TaskId, 0 AS src, tu.Role, tu.Id, tu.UserId,
               NULLIF(tu.DepartmentId, '') AS dept, t2.TargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task_user` tu
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2 ON t2.TaskId = tu.TaskId
        WHERE t2.AssignDepartment = '490.698' AND t2.DeletedDate IS NULL AND t2.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t2.TaskId, 1, NULL, NULL, t2.TargetUser, NULLIF(t2.TargetDepartment, ''), t2.TargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2
        WHERE t2.AssignDepartment = '490.698' AND t2.DeletedDate IS NULL AND t2.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
          AND t2.TargetUser IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT t2.TaskId, 2, NULL, NULL, t2.AssignUser, NULLIF(t2.AssignDepartment, ''), t2.TargetDepartment
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t2
        WHERE t2.AssignDepartment = '490.698' AND t2.DeletedDate IS NULL AND t2.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
          AND t2.AssignUser IS NOT NULL
    ) p
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u
            ON u.eGovUserId = p.UserId

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT udpj.user_id,
               NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING(MAX(CONCAT(
                   IF(CAST(udpj.department_id AS CHAR) = SUBSTRING_INDEX(uu.DepartmentPath, '.', -1), 1, 0),
                   IF(udpj.is_primary > 0, 1, 0),
                   LPAD(udpj.id, 12, '0'),
                   COALESCE(jt.JobTitlesName, '')
               )), 15)), '') AS job_title
        FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`user_department_position_jobtitle` udpj
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`jobtitles` jt ON jt.JobTitlesId = udpj.jobtitle_id
        INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` uu ON uu.eGovUserId = udpj.user_id
        WHERE COALESCE(udpj.status, 1) = 1
        GROUP BY udpj.user_id
    ) ujt
           ON ujt.user_id = u.eGovUserId

    GROUP BY p.TaskId
) ppl
    ON ppl.TaskId = t.TaskId

/* NHÓM GỘP (cùng khóa GROUP BY ten_nhiem_vu, id_truc_giao của qlnv_tonghop_gop_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp)
   Điều kiện lọc phải giữ giống hệt WHERE bên dưới để MIN(TaskId) khớp bảng gộp.
   MySQL 5.7 không có MIN() OVER (...); Title varchar(6000) không tạo được auto key cho bảng dẫn xuất
   => JOIN theo MD5(Title) 32 ký tự (JOIN thẳng Title bị nested loop > 60s). */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MD5(t3.Title) AS title_md5, t3.AssignDepartment, CONCAT(MIN(t3.TaskId), '_GR') AS id_cha
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t3
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r3
            ON r3.ResolutionId = t3.ResolutionId
           AND r3.DeletedDate IS NULL
    WHERE t3.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND (   t3.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
           OR (t3.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t3.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t3.CompletedDate, t3.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
      AND t3.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
      AND t3.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
      AND t3.TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
    GROUP BY MD5(t3.Title), t3.AssignDepartment
) g
       ON g.title_md5 = MD5(t.Title)
      AND g.AssignDepartment = t.AssignDepartment

WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
  AND t.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
  AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
  AND t.TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')

GROUP BY t.TaskId

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    id_truc_giao = VALUES(id_truc_giao),
    truc_giao = VALUES(truc_giao),
    nhom_van_ban = VALUES(nhom_van_ban),
    linh_vuc = VALUES(linh_vuc),
    chu_de = VALUES(chu_de),
    muc_do_uu_tien = VALUES(muc_do_uu_tien),
    nv_quantam = VALUES(nv_quantam),
    ma_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ma_nhiem_vu),
    ten_nhiem_vu = VALUES(ten_nhiem_vu),
    van_ban_giao = VALUES(van_ban_giao),
    id_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(id_don_vi_chu_tri),
    ten_don_vi_chu_tri = VALUES(ten_don_vi_chu_tri),
    lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien = VALUES(lanh_dao_don_vi_va_chuyen_vien),
    ngay_giao = VALUES(ngay_giao),
    han_xu_ly = VALUES(han_xu_ly),
    ngay_hoan_thanh = VALUES(ngay_hoan_thanh),
    ngay_xoa = VALUES(ngay_xoa),
    tinh_trang = VALUES(tinh_trang),
    tinh_hinh_ket_qua = VALUES(tinh_hinh_ket_qua),
    ld_ubnd = VALUES(ld_ubnd),
    ld_van_phong = VALUES(ld_van_phong),
    phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi = VALUES(phong_chuyen_mon_theo_doi),
    chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi = VALUES(chuyen_vien_vp_theo_doi),
    id_cha = VALUES(id_cha),
    status = VALUES(status),
    sync_date = VALUES(sync_date);

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).

properties.Replacement Value:
INSERT INTO `datamart_hanoi`.`qlnv_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp` (
    `task_id`,
    `id_cha`,
    `status`,
    `id_truc_giao`,
    `truc_giao`,
    `van_ban_giao`,
    `ma_nhiem_vu`,
    `ten_nhiem_vu`,
    `chu_de`,
    `id_don_vi_giao`,
    `don_vi_giao`,
    `id_nguoi_giao`,
    `nguoi_giao`,
    `id_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_chu_tri`,
    `ten_don_vi_thuc_hien`,
    `id_nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `nguoi_thuc_hien`,
    `lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach`,
    `ngay_giao`,
    `han_xu_ly`,
    `ngay_hoan_thanh`,
    `ngay_chap_nhan`,
    `ngay_xoa`,
    `tinh_trang`,
    `ket_qua_thuc_hien`,
    `kho_khan_vuong_mac`,
    `de_xuat_kien_nghi`,
    `sync_date`
)

SELECT
    /* 1. KHÓA HỆ THỐNG & TRẠNG THÁI */
    t.TaskId                                                AS task_id,
    /* id_cha: task_id đầu tiên (nhỏ nhất) cùng (tên nhiệm vụ, trục giao) + '_GR', khớp id_cha bảng gộp */
    MAX(g.id_cha)                                           AS id_cha,
    t.Status                                                AS status,

    /* 2. NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ / TRỤC GIAO & VĂN BẢN GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_truc_giao,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, ''), MAX(d_assign_cap2.name)) AS truc_giao,
    t.DocCode                                               AS van_ban_giao,

    /* 3. THÔNG TIN NHIỆM VỤ, TIÊU ĐỀ & CHỦ ĐỀ */
    t.Code                                                  AS ma_nhiem_vu,
    t.Title                                                 AS ten_nhiem_vu,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(t.NameGroup, ''), 'Chưa phân loại')     AS chu_de,

    /* ĐƠN VỊ GIAO & NGƯỜI GIAO */
    t.AssignDepartment                                      AS id_don_vi_giao,
    COALESCE(MAX(d_assign.name), NULLIF(t.AssignOrganization, '')) AS don_vi_giao,
    t.AssignUser                                            AS id_nguoi_giao,
    MAX(u_assign.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_giao,

    /* 4. ĐƠN VỊ THỰC HIỆN / CHỦ TRÌ (CHUẨN HÓA CẤP) */
    CASE
        /* Nhánh 1841 / 1307 / 1310: chỉ đẩy về cấp 4 (cấp 5 -> cấp 4) */
        WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
          OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
        THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
        /* Còn lại: đẩy về cấp 3 (cấp 4 trở lên -> cấp 3) */
        ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
    END                                                     AS id_don_vi_chu_tri,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_chutri.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_chu_tri,

    COALESCE(
        MAX(d_donvi.name)
    )                                                       AS ten_don_vi_thuc_hien,

    /* 5. NGƯỜI THỰC HIỆN & LÃNH ĐẠO BAN PHỤ TRÁCH */
    t.TargetUser                                            AS id_nguoi_thuc_hien,
    MAX(u_target.eGovUserFullname)                          AS nguoi_thuc_hien,

    CONCAT_WS(' · ',
        COALESCE(MAX(u_target.eGovUserPositionName), NULLIF(t.ChargeUser, ''))
    )                                                       AS lanh_dao_ban_phu_trach,

    /* 6. CÁC MỐC THỜI GIAN */
    DATE_FORMAT(t.StartedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_giao,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ExpireDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                   AS han_xu_ly,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.CompletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                AS ngay_hoan_thanh,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.ApprovedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                 AS ngay_chap_nhan,
    DATE_FORMAT(t.DeletedDate, '%d/%m/%Y')                  AS ngay_xoa,

    /* 7. PHÂN LOẠI 4 TÌNH TRẠNG CHUẨN */
    CASE
        /* 1. Đã hoàn thành (đúng hạn hoặc quá hạn) */
        WHEN t.Status IN (3, 4)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'

        /* 2. Thường xuyên (nhiệm vụ không có hạn) */
        WHEN t.ExpireDate IS NULL
        THEN 'Thường xuyên'

        /* 3. Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

        /* 4. Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn */
        WHEN t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
             AND t.ExpireDate IS NOT NULL
             AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < CURDATE()
        THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
    END                                                     AS tinh_trang,

    /* 8. CHI TIẾT TÌNH HÌNH & BÁO CÁO (Lấy bản ghi mới nhất) */
    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT rp.Content 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        t.Content,
        '—'
    )                                                       AS ket_qua_thuc_hien,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Difficulty, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS kho_khan_vuong_mac,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT NULLIF(rp.Suggestion, '') 
            FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_report` rp 
            WHERE rp.TaskId = t.TaskId 
              AND rp.DeletedDate IS NULL 
            ORDER BY rp.CreatedDate DESC, rp.ReportId DESC 
            LIMIT 1
        ), 
        '—'
    )                                                       AS de_xuat_kien_nghi,

    '${sync_ts}'                                                   AS sync_date

FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t

/* JOIN NHÓM NHIỆM VỤ: LỌC TRỰC TIẾP ID NHÓM '55', 132 */
INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r
        ON r.ResolutionId = t.ResolutionId
       AND r.DeletedDate IS NULL
    --    AND r.ResolutionGroupId IN (55, 132)

/* JOIN TÊN ĐƠN VỊ TRỤC GIAO CẤP 2 */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign_cap2
       ON d_assign_cap2.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', 2), '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_assign_cap2.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ GIAO (BÓC TÁCH ID TỪ T.ASSIGNDEPARTMENT ĐỂ LẤY TÊN) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_assign
       ON d_assign.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.AssignDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_assign.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN NGƯỜI GIAO NHIỆM VỤ */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_assign
       ON u_assign.eGovUserId = t.AssignUser

/* JOIN ĐƠN VỊ CHỦ TRÌ (theo id cấp đã chuẩn hóa) */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_chutri
       ON d_chutri.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                END,
                '.',
                -1
            ) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(
                CASE
                    WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1841%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1307%'
                      OR t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.1310%'
                    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 4)
                    ELSE SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', 3)
                END,
                '.',
                -1
            ) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_chutri.IsDelete = 0

LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`department` d_donvi
       ON d_donvi.id = CASE
            WHEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
            THEN CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.TargetDepartment, '.', -1) AS UNSIGNED)
            ELSE NULL
          END
      AND d_donvi.IsDelete = 0

/* JOIN USER NHẬN */
LEFT JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_user` u_target 
       ON u_target.eGovUserId = t.TargetUser

/* JOIN NHÓM GỘP (cùng khóa GROUP BY ten_nhiem_vu, id_truc_giao của qlnv_tonghop_gop_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp)
   Điều kiện lọc phải giữ giống hệt WHERE bên dưới để MIN(TaskId) khớp bảng gộp.
   MySQL 5.7 không có MIN() OVER (...) => dùng subquery gom nhóm.
   Title là varchar(6000) => không tạo được auto key cho bảng dẫn xuất, JOIN thẳng theo Title
   thành nested loop N x M (> 60s, bị cắt kết nối) => JOIN theo MD5(Title) 32 ký tự. */
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT MD5(t3.Title) AS title_md5, t3.AssignDepartment, CONCAT(MIN(t3.TaskId), '_GR') AS id_cha
    FROM `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_task` t3
    INNER JOIN `db_theodoinv_hn`.`qlnv_resolution` r3
            ON r3.ResolutionId = t3.ResolutionId
           AND r3.DeletedDate IS NULL
    WHERE t3.DeletedDate IS NULL
      AND (   t3.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
           OR (t3.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t3.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t3.CompletedDate, t3.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
      AND t3.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
      AND t3.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
      AND t3.TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
    GROUP BY MD5(t3.Title), t3.AssignDepartment
) g
       ON g.title_md5 = MD5(t.Title)
      AND g.AssignDepartment = t.AssignDepartment

/* ĐIỀU KIỆN LẤY TASK: đồng bộ với qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nvgiao_pth_ubndtp */
WHERE t.DeletedDate IS NULL
  AND (   t.Status IN (-1, 0, 1, 2)
       OR (t.Status IN (3, 4) AND (t.ExpireDate IS NULL OR COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) IS NOT NULL)))
  /* UBND giao (đúng 490.698) cho đơn vị con 490.698.x, trừ 1307 / 1841 / 1310 */
  AND t.AssignDepartment = '490.698'
  AND t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698.%'
  AND t.TargetDepartment NOT IN ('490.698.1307', '490.698.1841', '490.698.1310')
  /* Loại nhóm văn bản 82, 109 */
--   AND r.ResolutionGroupId NOT IN (82, 109)

/* GOM NHÓM THEO TASK_ID ĐỂ KHỬ TRÙNG LẶP */
GROUP BY t.TaskId

/* UPSERT theo PK task_id thay cho TRUNCATE + INSERT: bảng không bị rỗng giữa chu kỳ.
   Bản ghi không còn thỏa điều kiện bị xóa ở bước sau (sync_date < ${sync_ts}). */
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE

Replacement Strategy.name: Replacement Strategy
Replacement Strategy.description: The strategy for how and what to replace within the FlowFile's text content.

allowableValue.description: Insert the Replacement Value at the beginning of the FlowFile or the beginning of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be prepended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be prepended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be prepended to the entire text.

Insert the Replacement Value at the end of the FlowFile or the end of each line (depending on the Evaluation Mode). For "Line-by-Line" Evaluation Mode, the value will be appended to each line. Similarly, for "First-Line", "Last-Line", "Except-Last-Line" and "Except-First-Line" Evaluation Modes,the value will be appended to header alone, footer alone, all lines except header and all lines except footer respectively. For "Entire Text" evaluation mode,the value will be appended to the entire text.

Prepends text before the start of the FlowFile (or the start of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property) as well as appending text to the end of the FlowFile (or the end of each line, depending on the configuration of the Evaluation Mode property)

Interpret the Search Value as a Regular Expression and replace all matches with the Replacement Value. The Replacement Value may reference Capturing Groups used in the Search Value by using a dollar-sign followed by the Capturing Group number, such as $1 or $2. If the Search Value is set to .* then everything is replaced without even evaluating the Regular Expression.
Search for all instances of the Search Value and replace the matches with the Replacement Value.

Always replaces the entire line or the entire contents of the FlowFile (depending on the value of the <Evaluation Mode> property) and does not bother searching for any value. When this strategy is chosen, the <Search Value> property is ignored.

Substitute variable references (specified in ${var} form) using FlowFile attributes for looking up the replacement value by variable name. When this strategy is chosen, both the <Search Value> and <Replacement Value> properties are ignored.

Regular Expression.name: Regular Expression
Regular Expression.description: The Search Value to search for in the FlowFile content. Only used for 'Literal Replace' and 'Regex Replace' matching strategies

Replacement Value.name: Replacement Value
Replacement Value.description: The value to insert using the 'Replacement Strategy'. Using "Regex Replace" back-references to Regular Expression capturing groups are supported, but back-references that reference capturing groups that do not exist in the regular expression will be treated as literal value. Back References may also be referenced using the Expression Language, as '$1', '$2', etc. The single-tick marks MUST be included, as these variables are not "Standard" attribute names (attribute names must be quoted unless they contain only numbers, letters, and _).

Text to Prepend.name: Text to Prepend
Text to Prepend.description: The text to prepend to the start of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Text to Append.name: Text to Append
Text to Append.description: The text to append to the end of the FlowFile, or each line, depending on teh configured value of the Evaluation Mode property

Character Set.name: Character Set
Character Set.description: The Character Set in which the file is encoded

Maximum Buffer Size.name: Maximum Buffer Size
Maximum Buffer Size.description: Specifies the maximum amount of data to buffer (per file or per line, depending on the Evaluation Mode) in order to apply the replacement. If 'Entire Text' (in Evaluation Mode) is selected and the FlowFile is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, if a single line is larger than this value, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure'. A default value of 1 MB is provided, primarily for 'Entire Text' mode. In 'Line-by-Line' Mode, a value such as 8 KB or 16 KB is suggested. This value is ignored if the <Replacement Strategy> property is set to one of: Append, Prepend, Always Replace

Evaluation Mode.name: Evaluation Mode
Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) or buffer the entire file into memory (Entire Text) and run against that.

Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.name: Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode
Line-by-Line Evaluation Mode.description: Run the 'Replacement Strategy' against each line separately (Line-by-Line) for all lines in the FlowFile, First Line (Header) alone, Last Line (Footer) alone, Except the First Line (Header) or Except the Last Line (Footer).
